how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warlock-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7623:obj:0: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7623:obj:1: BUse the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.
rows.quest:7623:details:0: Mor'zul says that you want to open a portal to Xoroth. To do that, you'll need Xorothian stardust. That's not easy to find on ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:7623:details:1: BThere is one being who might have some: Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar, the seat of the ⟦E3⟧! Speak with him and he might part with the stardust.
rows.quest:7623:details:2: BBut if you're going to Jaedenar, then you'll need to cloak yourself in the ⟦E3⟧'s own flavor of evil. That will require some of my shadowy potions, and that will cost you...
rows.quest:7623:completion:0: My patience spans the millenia, warlock. But do not think that allows you more than an instant of my time...
rows.quest:7624:obj:0: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.
rows.quest:7624:details:0: You wish to enter my good graces? Then kill for me.
rows.quest:7624:details:1: BMy servant, Ulathek, is pathetic how he grovels before me, all the while plotting with Lord Hel'nurath on Xoroth. Hel'nurath plans to usurp my power here, and Ulathek is his spy...
rows.quest:7624:details:2: BProve that you serve me and not my rivals. Confront Ulathek in his quarters, in the Shadow Hold to the west. Tell him that I know his secret and watch as fear grips him. Then, bring me the traitor's heart!
rows.quest:7624:completion:0: Ah, how splendid! After rotting a week, this heart will prove a succulent treat! Perhaps I will send for Ulathek's head and place it before me as I eat...
rows.quest:7624:completion:1: BYou have done me a service, warlock, and so my patience for you has grown. Marginally.
rows.quest:7625:obj:0: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7625:details:0: So you come to me seeking Xorothian stardust? You wish to open a portal to Xoroth, the domain of Hel'nurath my rival? Perhaps you plan to steal from him one of his precious dreadsteeds?
rows.quest:7625:details:1: BVery well. My servant Ur'dan has a supply of Xorothian stardust. You may obtain it from him... if you can pay the price.
rows.quest:7625:completion:0: There it is! I can hardly believe you got it! You must have struck a big deal with that Dreadlord or else paid a large sum, or both!
rows.quest:7625:completion:1: BMor'zul will have his ink very soon and then he can finally make the glyph parchment, so you can open a portal to Xoroth and pull through it one of the famed dreadsteeds!
rows.quest:7626:obj:0: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7626:details:0: A Bell of Dethmoora, named after the late warlock Dethmoora Darkeyes, is one of the three tools needed to create a Circle of Greater Summoning. When properly atuned with the Wheel and the Candle, these items conduct vast stores of arcane power.
rows.quest:7626:details:1: BMy servant Gorzeeki can construct such a bell, but to do so he will need a large supply of elixirs of shadow power. Procure the elixirs from an alchemist and bring them to Gorzeeki.
rows.quest:7626:completion:0: Very good! I hope these elixirs weren't too hard to get. Sometimes alchemists can be so miserly with their creations...
rows.quest:7626:completion:1: BI'll make the bell and keep it until you're ready for your ritual.
rows.quest:7627:obj:0: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7627:details:0: A Wheel of the Black March contains and directs the violent energies required for the Circle of Greater Summoning. For Gozeeki to construct a wheel, he will need both large brilliant shards from an enchanter, and dark iron ore from a master miner.
rows.quest:7627:details:1: BAcquire these and bring them to my servant.
rows.quest:7627:completion:0: There they are! I hear that dark iron ore is only found in the depths of Blackrock, and I'm sure these shards weren't easy to find either. I am often awed at the dedication you warlocks have. If you instead bent all that energy into the art of bug catching, oh... such a feast you would enjoy!
rows.quest:7627:completion:1: BSorry, a small digression. I'll create the wheel and keep it for you until you're ready for your ritual.
rows.quest:7628:obj:0: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7628:details:0: A Doomsday Candle stores fire and directs it at those who would disrupt your ritual. When creating your Circle of Greater Summoning, if your candle is lit then any wayward demons will be burned by its flames!
rows.quest:7628:details:1: BContaining that fire is not easy, and requires the essence within the scales of a black dragon. Acquire those scales from a skinner and bring them to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
rows.quest:7628:completion:0: Ah, very good. I'll need these to contain the fires of the candle. Now that I have the scales, I'll make the candle and hold onto it until you're ready to begin your ritual for the Circle of Greater Summoning.
rows.quest:7629:obj:0: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
rows.quest:7629:details:0: There is one more process required for Mor'zul's parchment; I need paper infused with Xorothian stardust. And... I'm afraid I can't do that here. I don't have the equipment!
rows.quest:7629:details:1: BThere is an alchemy lab, however, with everything needed. It's in the Scholomance, on the isle of ⟦E4⟧ in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7629:details:2: BI can't make the trip, but here - take this jar. There's an imp inside who is quite clever. Let him out at the alchemy lab and he'll infuse the parchment.
rows.quest:7629:completion:0: Ah, good. J'eevee created the parchment. How was the Scholomance? Charming, don't you think? And the bugs there... I hear they're delicious!
rows.quest:7629:completion:1: BWell done, ⟦1⟧, and thank you for returning my jar. I've had it for a long time... and it's not for sale!
rows.quest:7630:obj:0: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7630:details:0: Now that the Bell, Wheel and Candle are made, I should make a black lodestone. During your ritual, you'll need that lodestone to maintain the other ritual objects if they should fail.
rows.quest:7630:details:1: BTo make the lodestone, I require arcanite. Do you have any? If not, then... you'll have to get the arcanite from an alchemist.
rows.quest:7630:details:2: BReturn to me when you have the arcanite, and then I'll make the black lodestone.
rows.quest:7630:completion:0: You got it! Nicely done! Now I can create the lodestone. When you're finally ready for your ritual to create the Circle of Greater Summoning, you'll want a lodestone to make sure the ritual doesn't fizzle out!
rows.quest:7631:obj:0: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
rows.quest:7631:details:0: All the preparations are made. Now, you must perform the ritual to create a Circle of Greater Summoning, then use the parchment infused with Xorothian stardust... to open a portal to Xoroth.
rows.quest:7631:details:1: BI have written the instructions for the ritual onto a scroll. Study it closely, for you must perform each step exactly if you wish to succeed.
rows.quest:7631:details:2: BFortune to you, ⟦2⟧. And may the souls of your enemies swiftly find their way into your shard pouch.
rows.quest:7631:completion:0: The Xorothian Dreadsteed's spirit is beaten. Although rage pulses through its ghostly flanks, you know that the beast's soul is yours...
rows.quest:7631:completion:1: BIt whispers dark magic into your mind and instills within you the knowledge to summon a dreadsteed.
rows.quest:8419:obj:0: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8419:details:0: ⟦3⟧, an imp in ⟦E6⟧ by the name of Impsy has requested your presence. It is somewhat strange, as he has asked that you bring a piece of felcloth as a sign of good faith. Considering the power you already wield as a warlock, I can only assume you know the satyrs of ⟦E6⟧ carry this felcloth.
rows.quest:8419:details:1: BYou can find Impsy just north of the Bloodvenom Falls, which I've heard is quite lovely this time of year.
rows.quest:8419:completion:0: What a splendid warlock you are!
rows.quest:8419:completion:1: B<Impsy holds the felcloth to his face.>
rows.quest:8419:completion:2: BOh how I love the feel of it, the way it burns your skin and weaves evil thoughts through the mind...
rows.quest:8420:obj:0: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8420:details:0: Maybe this sounds strange coming from an imp, but I'd like a pet of my own. I really would. It's just not fair that Niby gets me and I get nothing!
rows.quest:8420:details:1: BIn fact, it doesn't even need to be a living pet. I'd need something to start making it with, like some felcloth. The satyrs here in ⟦E6⟧ sometimes have felcloth, so you'd just have to kill enough of them until you find some. That doesn't sound so bad, does it?
rows.quest:8420:completion:0: Wow! You are too kind. Especially for a warlock!
rows.quest:8420:completion:1: B<Impsy holds the felcloth to his face.>
rows.quest:8420:completion:2: BOh how I love the feel of it, the way it burns your skin and weaves evil thoughts through the mind...
rows.quest:8421:obj:0: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8421:details:0: Now that I have my felcloth, I can really begin making *my* pet.
rows.quest:8421:details:1: BIt's going to need some eyes though. Perhaps you could rip some rotting wood from the irontree folk for me, so I can carve out some lovely eyes. They're up north in the Irontree Woods.
rows.quest:8421:details:2: BI'll also need some bloodvenom essence to give it that new demon smell. The tainted oozes carry the essence, and they hang out right here near Niby and me.
rows.quest:8421:completion:0: This will work so very well.
rows.quest:8422:obj:0: Bring a total of 6 Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in sunken temple.
rows.quest:8422:details:0: My pet is almost done. Now I just need something to stuff it with.
rows.quest:8422:details:1: BOnly the voodoo feathers from the trolls in the sunken temple will do. They go by the names Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Kill them. Kill them all.
rows.quest:8422:details:2: BThis is no trivial task ⟦4⟧, so I'll make it worth your while by giving you something of Niby's -- he probably doesn't need it anyhow.
rows.quest:8422:completion:0: Wonderful, now my pet is complete!
rows.quest:8422:completion:1: B<Impsy quickly stuffs the doll and gives it a demonic hug.>
rows.quest:8422:completion:2: BOh, what an odd side effect these voodoo feathers have...
